fullPassage:
주어진 글: In June 1969, the polluted river caught fire. The likely cause was a burning flare falling from a train, which set fire to oil-soaked waste beneath a bridge. At that time, few people in Cleveland cared.

(A) The article featured a shocking photograph of flames and smoke rising from the river. But this was not a photograph of the 1969 fire, which was put out so quickly that nobody took a picture of it.

(B) This was because fires had been recorded on the Cuyahoga more than ten times before, and some of them had been much worse. However, it wasn't long before the 1969 fire became famous.

(C) This was thanks to an article published in Time magazine that year. Still, the image had a great impact on people.

questions.passage: As quickly as a camera captures a scene, an image can grab hold of our emotions. Through speech or written text, it can be difficult <u>ⓐ to convey</u> a complex message quickly. Yet photographs can change people's hearts and minds in an instant. And when the magic of photography <u>ⓑ sparks</u> an emotional reaction in a great number of people, it can change history. In the 1880s, industry began <u>ⓒ to grow</u> rapidly along the Cuyahoga River. This industrial growth <u>ⓓ provided</u> steady jobs to people in the area. Meanwhile, steel mills and factories started <u>ⓔ dump</u> large amounts of waste into the river.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중에서 어법상 어색한 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 제철소와 공장들이 대량의 폐기물을 강에 버리기 시작했다. start는 to부정사 또는 동명사를 목적어로 취하는 동사입니다. dump(동사원형)는 올 수 없으므로 dumping 또는 to dump로 고쳐야 합니다.
det.analysis: 원문: steel mills and factories started dump large amounts of waste into the river.
det.tip: 어법 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: However, it wasn't long before the 1969 fire became famous. This was thanks to an article (A) <u>[published / publishing]</u> in Time magazine that year. The article featured a shocking photograph of flames and smoke (B) <u>[rising / risen]</u> from the river. But this was not a photograph of the 1969 fire, (C) <u>[which / what]</u> was put out so quickly that nobody took a picture of it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: (A) 타임지에 게재된 기사 — article과 publish는 수동 관계(기사가 게재되는 것)이므로 과거분사 published. (B) 강에서 피어오르는 화염과 연기 — flames/smoke와 rise는 능동 관계(화염이 피어오르는 것)이므로 현재분사 rising. (C) 앞의 the 1969 fire를 선행사로 받는 계속적 용법의 관계대명사 which가 적절합니다. what은 선행사를 포함하므로 콤마 뒤에 올 수 없습니다.
det.analysis: 원문: (A) an article published in Time magazine (B) flames and smoke rising from the river (C) the 1969 fire, which was put out so quickly
det.tip: 어법 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: Lewis Hine, a teacher and photographer, wanted to reveal how cruel this system was. So he quit his teaching job and started to work for the National Child Labor Committee as an investigative photographer. He gained access to factories by <u>ⓐ pretending</u> to have different jobs like insurance agent or fire inspector. Once inside, he would photograph the children <u>ⓑ working</u> there. He would also ask their names and ages and record information about their <u>ⓒ living</u> and working conditions. From 1908 to 1912, he secretly gathered information and took photographs to expose factory owners who <u>ⓓ was taking</u> advantage of helpless children.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓓ 중에서 어법상 어색한 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: 무력한 아이들을 이용하고 있던 공장 소유주들. 선행사 factory owners(복수)이므로 관계대명사절의 동사도 복수형이어야 합니다. 따라서 was taking이 아닌 were taking이 와야 합니다.
det.analysis: 원문: factory owners who was taking advantage of helpless children
det.tip: 어법 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

As a result, the Cuyahoga River fire of 1969 became a (C) <u>[symbol / solution]</u> of pollution.

det.korean: 점점 더 많은 사람들이 환경 보호의 필요성을 인식하게 되었고, 불타는 강의 충격적인 이미지가 수질 오염에 대한 대중의 분노를 촉발했다. 쿠야호가 강 화재는 오염의 상징이 되었다.
det.analysis: 원문: More and more people were becoming aware of the need to protect the environment, and the shocking image sparked public anger about water pollution. The Cuyahoga River fire of 1969 became a symbol of pollution.

questions.passage: In the 19th century, the Industrial Revolution led to a dramatic increase in factory production in the United States. questions.stem:
다음 문장이 본문의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"In 1938, the United States Congress passed an act that made it illegal for children under fourteen to work in factories during school hours."

det.korean: 16세 미만의 아동이 수업 시간에 공장에서 일하는 것을 불법으로 만들었다. 제시된 문장은 'under fourteen(14세 미만)'이라고 했으나, 원문은 'under sixteen(16세 미만)'이므로 불일치(F)입니다.
det.analysis: 원문: made it illegal for children under sixteen to work in factories during school hours
det.tip: T/F 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: More and more people were becoming aware of the need to protect the environment, and the shocking image of the burning river sparked public anger about water pollution. As a result, the Cuyahoga River fire of 1969 became a symbol of pollution. A national environmental awareness event was held on April 22, 1970, which later became known as the first Earth Day.
questions.stem:
다음 글을 읽고, 빈칸에 들어갈 적절한 단어를 <보기>에서 골라 쓰시오.

[조건]
• 반드시 <보기>의 단어를 사용할 것
• 한 단어로 쓸 것

[보기] symbol / solution / cause

As a result, the Cuyahoga River fire of 1969 became a __________ of pollution.

det.korean: 1969년 쿠야호가 강 화재는 오염의 상징이 되었다. symbol은 '상징'이라는 뜻으로, 특정 사건이 더 큰 문제를 대표하게 된다는 의미입니다.
det.analysis: 원문: the Cuyahoga River fire of 1969 became a symbol of pollution
det.tip: 서술형 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: These examples show that photographs can bring meaningful change to society. They prove that, sometimes, a picture truly is worth a thousand words.
questions.stem:
다음 <조건>에 맞게 주어진 우리말을 영작하시오.

[조건]
• 아래 <보기>의 단어를 모두 사용하여 한 문장으로 작성할 것
• 필요시 단어의 형태를 변형할 것

[보기] photograph / bring / meaningful / change / society

[우리말] 이 예시들은 사진이 사회에 의미 있는 변화를 가져올 수 있음을 보여준다.

det.korean: 이 예시들은 사진이 사회에 의미 있는 변화를 가져올 수 있음을 보여준다. show that + 주어 + 동사(명사절)의 구조이며, bring change to = ~에 변화를 가져오다라는 구문이 핵심입니다.
det.analysis: 원문: These examples show that photographs can bring meaningful change to society.
det.tip: 서술형 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: What is more, the children's faces showed the tragic impact of hard labor. When people saw the children's joyless expressions, they could not help but feel heartbroken.
questions.stem:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 올바른 형태로 고쳐 쓰시오.

When people saw the children's joyless expressions, they could not help but (feel) heartbroken.

det.korean: 그들은 가슴이 아프지 않을 수 없었다. cannot help but + 동사원형 구문에서 but 뒤에는 동사원형이 옵니다. 따라서 feel(동사원형)이 그대로 정답입니다.
det.analysis: 원문: they could not help but feel heartbroken
det.tip: 서술형 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.
